title: OG Anunoby Reacts to Oscar Award Winning Actress Anne Hathaway's Viral 'Bucket List' Moment at MSG
htmlContent:
Anne Hathaway is a famous actress for her iconic roles in The Devil Wears Prada and The Dark Knight Rises. Found herself at the center of a surprising courtside incident during the recent game between the New York Knicks and the Chicago Bulls at Madison Square Garden. Hathaway and her family were watching the game when Knicks forward OG Anunoby, who was chasing a loose ball, nearly knocked her off her feet, literally. Anunoby deflected Josh Giddey's pass intended for Zach LaVine, sending the ball flying towards the high-priced seats. Anunoby's quick reaction to secure the ball brought the 6-foot-7, 232-pound player to within inches of Hathaway's courtside position. The near collision, captured by fans and quickly circulated on social media, showcased the unpredictable excitement of watching the game from the courtside.

Hathaway's Hilarious Take on the Incident

Hathaway used Instagram to address the heart-stopping moment with humor and grace. “I almost got crashed into last night!” she exclaimed in a video, adding with a smile, “I always wanted that to happen!” Describing the incident as a “bucket list moment,”the Oscar-winning actress appeared to be unshakable and even thankful for the encounter. Fans appreciated Hathaway's cheerful reaction, which enabled her to laugh off a potentially serious situation.

OG Anunoby’s Cool Response

Known for his calm demeanor on and off the court, Anunoby shared a short but amusing 'You're welcome' on social media to acknowledge Hathaway's post. The viral moment added levity to an otherwise intense matchup, despite his focus being on the game.

Knicks vs. Bulls Recap

In a thrilling game, the Knicks narrowly lost to the Bulls, 124-123, on the court. Anunoby produced a solid performance, putting forth 14 points, nine rebounds, multiple assists, and blocks. Despite missing out on a double-double, his performance showed his recent strong form, averaging 21 points and 6.3 rebounds in the past three games, with a 56% shooting efficiency. The Knicks' loss underscored the difficulties they encounter in a competitive season, but Anunoby's constant performance remains a positive aspect for the team.

A Star-Studded Night at the Garden

Madison Square Garden was lit up by a variety of celebrities that evening. Lauren Cohan and Michael J. were among the stars who visited the iconic venue. The electric atmosphere was made even more electrifying by Fox, Queen Latifah, and Fat Joe. As the Knicks progress through their homestand, MSG is still attracting A-listers, and fans are eagerly anticipating their next games and potential celebrity cameos. The unexpected encounter with Anunoby may have been a brief moment for Hathaway. It was an experience she won't forget and proves that sitting courtside at an NBA game has its own set of thrills and surprises.
